my_rule.description: The rule you currently hold, in one sentence.

rival_rule.description: The strongest competing reading of the evidence so far, in one sentence.

predicted_output.description: The output your rule gives for this input.

rival_output.description: The output the rival reading gives for this input.

tools.description: Exploration stage only. Ask for another example: submit an input grid; the environment returns the transformed output grid. Each successful call increases your query count by 1. Also give your current rule, the strongest rival reading, and the output each predicts for this input. Choose inputs on which the two readings disagree, built at the full scale of the example.

tools.name: request_test
tools.description: Exploration stage only. Request the final test and receive a held-out test input grid.

result.message: Testing stage. You will be given 3 test inputs, one at a time and answered separately. Apply the same transformation rule to each and submit the predicted output grid with submit_final_answer.
